body.estimand_functional: \(\widehat\tau_{t,\ell}=\widehat Q^I_{0t,\ell}-\sum_{j=1}^J\widehat w_{\ell j}\widehat Q_{jt,\ell}\), with \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}=\sum_{j=1}^Jw_{\ell j}Q_{jt,\ell}\), exact finite-array loss \(m_\ell^{-1/2}\Psi^{\mathrm{fin}}_{t,\ell}+n_\ell^{-1}A_{t,\ell}(v_\ell)-2(n_\ell m_\ell)^{-1/2}v_\ell^\top B_{t,\ell}\) plus the three displayed \(\epsilon_{t,\ell}\) terms, and the total pilot-split certified radius \(R_\ell\) satisfying \(R_\ell^2/a_\ell\to c^*(\eta,\alpha)\) conditionally on every supported fixed local stratum while retaining cross-cell translations and face offsets in the nuisance supremum.

sampling_model.design: Fixed \(J\), \(T_0\), and \(T_1\) repeated-cross-section distributional synthetic-control panel in which one simplex weight \(w_\ell\) spans the treated no-intervention quantile law in every pre-treatment and post-treatment panel period.
sampling_model.units: The treated and donor cell laws are fixed primitives; each pre cell contributes \(n_\ell\) independent draws and each post cell contributes \(m_\ell\) independent draws.
sampling_model.treatment: Only unit \(j=0\) is intervened upon after period \(T_0\); donor post laws and \(F^I_{0t,\ell}\) are observed, while \(F^N_{0t,\ell}\) is the post-treatment no-intervention counterfactual identified by the same \(w_\ell\) learned from pre-treatment periods.
sampling_model.overlap: No atom-mass lower bound, post-knot separation, interior-weight restriction, or restriction on \(n_\ell/m_\ell\) is imposed.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The first \(\lceil n_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) pre observations and \(\lceil m_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) post observations in every cell form a deterministic pilot; the remaining observations form the independent main-sample center. Simultaneous CDF, variance-adaptive multinomial-mass, density-difference, Gram, weight, and covariance regions are combined with deterministic support, covariance-rank, and simplex-face enumeration. Within-cell root-post-sample mass gaps are consistently learned, including pilot-unseen-mass control, while cross-cell knot translations and root-pre-sample face offsets stay in the certified nuisance supremum. The matrix \(H\), limiting weight \(w^0\), and covariance \(\Omega\) appear only after local-subsequence extraction.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Section~5.3.2 and Proposition~5 provide a published discrete distributional-synthetic-control goodness-of-fit limit; its version-of-record formula was not accessible for a finer claim.

The version-of-record Summary states that counterfactuals are identified by matching treated pre-intervention quantile residuals to a convex combination of control residuals orthogonal to observable common factors.
Section~6.2, Assumptions~4--6, and Corollary~3 give DSC inference for smooth continuous empirical quantiles with a donor-dilution condition.
Theorem~2 gives a convergence rate for DSC weights under interior-weight and quantile-draw conditions.
Theorem~2 transforms simultaneous distribution-function bands into valid bands for discrete quantile functions.
The main theorem gives an asymptotically uniformly valid confidence set for a simplex-valued optimizer weight.
Theorem~1 gives uniformly asymptotically valid conditional critical values with a functional nuisance parameter.
Theorem~1 gives finite-sample validity and size exactness for active-rank Gaussian moment-inequality testing.

body.tldr: Exact discrete distributional synthetic control identifies the treated unit's no-intervention quantile law in every pre-treatment and post-treatment panel period with one stable simplex weight. Its QTE estimator has two first-order error sources on different scales: an exact finite-array signed endpoint energy from empirical post-period atoms and a cone-projected quadratic from simplex weight estimation. The exact squared-error decomposition also retains the pre-weight--post-quantile cross term and three donor-quantile remainder terms; pulse geometry makes them vanish under every headline normalization. Uniform identification is imposed on the finite-array Grams \(H_\ell\), while \(H\), the limiting weight \(w^0\), and the triangular pre-score covariance \(\Omega\) enter only after local-subsequence extraction. The project proves rate-optimal uniformly honest simultaneous \(L^2\) QTE balls and the least common deterministic conditional cutoff. A pilot split of sizes \(\lceil n_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\) and \(\lceil m_\ell^{3/4}\rceil\), simultaneous primitive regions, exhaustive support/rank/face enumeration, certified rational Gaussian calculation, explicit error budgets, and a deterministic work bound now give one total measurable radius that attains this conditional cutoff on every supported fixed local stratum, with a vanishing DKW fallback. Root-post-sample within-cell masses are learned, whereas cross-cell translations and simplex-face offsets remain in the nuisance supremum. Oracle calibration occurs only on separated interior strata with continuous nondegenerate critical law. The Bernoulli 95 percent honesty bracket \((1.913,1.914]\), versus collision-oracle value \(1.38590382435\), proves that the nonregular honesty penalty cannot be adapted away.

project_justification.gap: Chen's published DSC identifies counterfactuals by pre-intervention quantile-residual matching, Gunsilius supplies the quantile-span model and discrete goodness-of-fit asymptotics, and Alvarez--Orestes gives direct DSC inference under smooth continuous-cell and donor-dilution conditions. None supplies a measurable uniformly honest radius that combines an exact stable post-treatment no-intervention span, atomic endpoint conditioning, estimated simplex faces, changing covariance rank, primitive nuisance exclusion, uniform raw-to-Gaussian transfer, and certified common-cutoff attainment; no formula-level claim about Gunsilius Proposition~5 is used because its version-of-record equation was inaccessible.
project_justification.niche: Fixed donors, independent pre and post cell samples, one exact span weight across all pre-treatment and post-treatment no-intervention laws, and finite-support post laws generate a two-scale face--knot experiment. A root-three-quarter pilot learns limiting design, covariance, support, and within-cell local mass gaps, while root-scale cross-cell translations and face offsets remain nuisance. The main sample supplies the QTE center, and a certified finite-dimensional nuisance supremum preserves honesty through collisions, covariance-rank changes, and simplex boundaries.
project_justification.fill: The paper fills the gap with the exact six-term finite-array loss decomposition, pulse-sharp cross-term control, triangular pre-score linearization with explicit covariance, three phase laws, component degeneracy criteria, rate-optimal DKW fallback, Bernoulli honesty penalty, conditional minimax common-cutoff calculation, and one total Borel pilot-split certified radius. Simultaneous primitive regions with exclusion budget \(\beta_\ell=(n_\ell\wedge m_\ell)^{-2}\), exhaustive compatible support/rank/face enumeration, Gaussian transfer and tail cushions, rational interval arithmetic, and a deterministic work bound yield uniform asymptotic coverage, conditional cutoff convergence, and vanishing fallback on supported fixed local strata.

body.related_work: Chen's Journal of Applied Econometrics article is a direct DSC comparator: it identifies counterfactuals by matching treated pre-intervention quantile residuals to a convex combination of control residuals. Gunsilius establishes the Wasserstein-quantile DSC model and a discrete goodness-of-fit result, while Alvarez and Orestes treat smooth continuous empirical quantiles with ridge regularization and donor dilution. Zhang, Zhang, and Zhang study prediction and weight rates under quantile-grid and interior-weight conditions; Sommerfeld and Munk provide finite-space Wasserstein directional limits; and Chernozhukov, Fernandez-Val, Melly, and Wuthrich project distribution bands into discrete quantile bands. Andrews supplies tangent-cone extremum asymptotics, Canen and Song address simplex-weight inference, Andrews and Mikusheva develop Gaussian nuisance conditioning, and Cox and Shi enumerate active constraints. Robins and van der Vaart and Hoffmann and Nickl establish general honesty-versus-adaptation obstructions. These works supply separate model, empirical-process, conditional-Gaussian, active-set, and honesty ingredients, but none states the present measurable pilot-split theorem: uniform raw-sample-to-Gaussian transfer through atomic support and covariance-rank changes, certified nuisance exclusion over cross-cell translations and simplex faces, a total common-cutoff radius, and vanishing fallback. Zhai et al. remain the same-question consumer for raw discrete mosquito-abundance QTE curves; their separate binary CDF and \(W_1\) elimination analysis is outside scope.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The local criterion minimizes only the common deterministic conditional squared-radius cutoff over \(\mathscr C_\eta\); it does not optimize expected radius, randomized rules, or arbitrary observation-dependent radius rules. The finite Gaussian object is a conditional leading-loss experiment, not an unrestricted deficiency equivalence for the raw samples. The pilot-split theorem supplies the uniform transfer needed for this radius and keeps an explicit vanishing cushion for linearization, nuisance exclusion, Gaussian tails, and numerical enclosure. The sharper cross term is nondegenerate only at its own finer scale and does not alter the cutoff. Cross-cell translations and face offsets remain nuisance near collisions and boundaries, and oracle calibration is asserted only on fixed separated interior strata with continuous nondegenerate critical law. Applying the result to Zhai et al. would additionally require a bridge for discrete pre-period outcomes, beta-weighted quantile fitting, period aggregation, spatial dependence, and interpolation.
body.honest_scope: The exact endpoint identity, exact six-term finite-array squared-error decomposition, pulse-sharp cross-vector limit, diagonal local compactification, triangular pre-score linearization with limiting weight \(w^0\) and covariance \(\Omega\), normalized compound loss, coupled three-phase limits, component degeneracy criteria, DKW upper rate, matching richness-conditional lower rate, Bernoulli honesty penalty, deterministic common cutoff, and pilot-split certified attainment theorem are proved. The stable-span model identifies \(Q^N_{0t,\ell}\) with the same \(w_\ell\) in every pre-treatment and post-treatment no-intervention period; it never equates the counterfactual law with \(Q^I_{0t,\ell}\). The total measurable radius is uniformly asymptotically honest and rate-optimal, has vanishing fallback on supported fixed local strata, learns within-cell local offsets, and converges conditionally to the common deterministic cutoff while retaining cross-cell translations and face offsets as nuisance. Oracle calibration is claimed only under fixed unscaled knot separation, weights bounded away from every face, and a continuous nondegenerate critical law. The Bernoulli calculation proves the unavoidable honesty penalty near collisions; no adaptation to the smaller collision-oracle cutoff is claimed. The result does not optimize randomized or general observation-dependent radii and does not cover Zhai et al.'s separate binary elimination estimand.
